name: Singlife One Clark International Marathon
short_description: The Singlife One Clark International Marathon was a full marathon, with 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km races, held on 20 September 2026 at the Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga, Philippines.
ai_summary: The Singlife One Clark International Marathon was held on Sunday 20 September 2026 at the Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga, Philippines, organised by RUNRIO Inc. with Go Clark as local organiser. The sixth leg of the Singlife Philippine Marathon Majors offered 42.195 km (midnight start), 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km races on World Athletics and AIMS-certified courses. The results list 3,296 entries; Kenyans Victor Kipkemei Chepkwony (2:24:28) and Ziporah Wanjiru Kingori (2:49:20) won the marathon.
pros: Water and sports drink about every 2 to 2.5 km, with bananas on the longer distances
Separate paid top ten for Filipino runners, with no qualifying time
A small women's marathon field: 3:55:12 was tenth overall in 2026
Marathon age-group winners qualify for guaranteed TCS Sydney Marathon places
Course certified by World Athletics and AIMS, according to the organiser
cons: No route map or elevation profile was published for 2026
No marathon cut-off time was published
Humid night air: a 25°C dew point at the midnight start, and light rain at 1am in 2026
Entries cannot be refunded, deferred or transferred
research_highlights: The race was held on 20 September 2026 at the Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga, with the marathon starting at midnight according to the timing data.
The race is the sixth leg of the newly launched Singlife Philippine Marathon Majors series organized by RUNRIO Inc. in partnership with local organizer GoRace PH/Go Clark.
Four distance categories are offered: 42K, 21K, 10K, and 5K, with over P1.2 million in cash prizes.
Race inclusions include a race singlet, bib, finisher medal, finisher towel, and loot bag, with 21K and 42K finishers also getting an exclusive finisher shirt.
The course runs through the wide roads of Clark Freeport Zone, an area with modern infrastructure and an aviation-related backdrop; organizers describe it as a fast, PR-friendly layout.

faqs.question: When is the Singlife One Clark International Marathon?
faqs.answer: It was held on Sunday 20 September 2026 at the Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga. Timing data show the marathon started at midnight, the 21 km at 2am, the 10 km at 4am and the 5 km at 5am. Race packs were collected at SM City Clark on 18 and 19 September.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: At the Clark Parade Grounds on Clark Avenue in Clark Freeport, Pampanga, the event venue and finish area. The courses used the wide roads of the Clark Freeport Zone and are certified by World Athletics and AIMS. Clark International Airport is about 4 km east of the Parade Grounds.

faqs.question: What distances are available for participants?
faqs.answer: Four: a 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km. Entry fees ranged from P1,435 for an early-bird 5 km to P3,535 for a late marathon entry, and only 21 km and 42 km finishers received a finisher's shirt. Hydration stations were every 2 to 2.5 km.
